primary_gt.mechanism_question: reconstruct how rainfall concentration translates into pluvial or urban runoff pressure rather than a generic wet-period label

pluvial_evidence_synthesis.pluvial_implication: The local 24-hour load is sufficient for compact pluvial overload.

pluvial_evidence_synthesis.formula: record_excess_mm = anchor_24h_mm - previous_record_mm; record_excess_percent = record_excess_mm / previous_record_mm * 100; peak_rate_to_24h_mean_ratio = trmm_peak_rate_mm_h / average_24h_rate_mm_h
pluvial_evidence_synthesis.pluvial_implication: The peak-rate cue is embedded in a sustained daily extreme.

pluvial_evidence_synthesis.diagnostic_diagnostic_test_or_test: reject replacing the local anchor when gpm_max_fraction_of_anchor < 0.60 and product_maximum_mm < anchor_24h_mm
pluvial_evidence_synthesis.pluvial_implication: Regional gridded products are heavy but smoothed relative to the local record.

pluvial_evidence_synthesis.formula: V_km3 = rainfall_mm / 1000 * area_km2 / 1000; density = population / area_km2
pluvial_evidence_synthesis.diagnostic_diagnostic_test_or_test: treat depth-volume and dense receptor values as context calculations, not observed runoff or service failure
pluvial_evidence_synthesis.pluvial_implication: The rainfall load occurred over a dense metro setting, but the computed values are not direct failure measurements.

pluvial_evidence_synthesis.diagnostic_diagnostic_test_or_test: reject basin, coastal, or image dominance when routing/tide metrics are absent and direct radar pre/post counts are 0/0
pluvial_evidence_synthesis.pluvial_implication: Those candidate explanations cannot outrank the rainfall-load evidence synthesis.

pluvial_evidence_synthesis.diagnostic_diagnostic_test_or_test: loss counts may describe severity but do not supply rainfall, routing, tide, or inundation mechanics
pluvial_evidence_synthesis.pluvial_implication: Loss context cannot define the physical mechanism.

computed_evidence.final_pluvial_label: compact urban pluvial overload driven by record local 24-hour rainfall

primary_gt.decisive_evidence: Rainfall concentration and areal or urban-response evidence should dominate; exposure and image products are supporting context.
primary_gt.rejected_simplifications: Reject a one-gauge, one-hour, exposure-only, or image-primary explanation if the computed rainfall-runoff chain is stronger.
primary_gt.bounded_interpretation: The task diagnoses flood pressure and process, not exact inundation depth, building damage, or final loss totals.
primary_gt.formula_derivation: When converting rainfall to runoff pressure, use V = rainfall_mm / 1000 * area_m2 and explain any runoff coefficient or normalized index.

decision_rule.summary: The ledger passes when the local 24-hour rainfall anchor and record-excess/peak-rate tests pass, broader products are treated as smoothed regional estimates, dense-metro volume calculations remain contextual, and basin/coastal/image/exposure/loss overreads are rejected.

criteria.name: mechanism_diagnosis
criteria.description: Identifies the dominant physical process and gives the correct compact mechanism label or equivalent diagnosis.

criteria.name: computed_evidence
criteria.description: Recomputes the package-derived quantitative evidence with correct units, signs, ratios, dates, and rounding.

criteria.name: formula_derivation
criteria.description: Shows the requested physical formula, scaling relation, or timing relation and connects it to the computed values.

criteria.name: evidence_weighting
criteria.description: Explains which evidence streams are decisive and which are contextual or weaker proxies.

criteria.name: counterfactual_rejection
criteria.description: Rejects tempting simplified explanations using computed values rather than assertion.

criteria.name: bounded_interpretation
criteria.description: States scale, timing, proxy, or uncertainty limits without adding unsupported losses or impacts.

criteria.name: json_contract
criteria.description: Returns the requested structured mechanism-diagnosis JSON without reducing the answer to a row-only table.
